subject: Configuration file for saving database connection string in Shiny - R

messages.author: 1c6fdf69a26a38bf
messages.subject: Configuration file for saving database connection string in Shiny - R
parts:
Hi,

Can we save the database connection string in a configuration file and refer in server.R file?

For example in the below code, instead of hard coding entire connection string values and passwords can we refer an external config file and use the connection string from there?


conn <- dbConnect(ch, "jdbc:sqlserver://ServerName ;databaseName="DBName", "userid","password")

=>

Conn <- dbConnect(ch, "connection string key from configuration file")

Thanks,
Sam
